summary: Wythe County, VA lookout of 1938 on Walker Mountain; the register says it was dismantled, leaving four footers and two concrete steps.

facts.design: 40' treated timber tower with 14'X14' cab and catwalk
facts.status_note: Dismantled; the register says only four footers and two concrete steps remain

visit.trail_note: Walker Mountain Trail, a maintained hiking trail along the ridge, passes the former tower location

events.note: Register gives 1938 as the build year of the 40' treated timber tower
Registered October 25, 2010; nominated by Dan East

evidence.supports: 40' treated timber tower, 14x14 cab with catwalk, built 1938 on Walker Mountain in NW Wythe County
evidence.quote: This 40' treated timber tower with 14'X14' Cab with catwalk, built in 1938, was located on Walker Mountain in the northwest portion of Wythe County, Virginia.

evidence.supports: Appalachian Trail used to pass the tower; trail relocated north in 1977
evidence.quote: The Appalachian Trail used to pass by the tower until the trail was relocated further north in 1977.

evidence.supports: trail relocated because of inadequate water on the ridge
evidence.quote: The trail was relocated due to inadequate water sources along the Walker Mountain ridge.

evidence.supports: tower dismantled; four footers and two concrete steps remain
evidence.quote: The tower has since been dismantled, and all that remains are the four footers and two concrete steps.
There is still a maintained hiking trail

evidence.supports: trail is named Walker Mountain Trail and follows the ridge
evidence.quote: which follows along the ridge of the mountain

evidence.supports: trail passes the former lookout tower location
evidence.quote: passes by the former lookout tower location

evidence.supports: Forest Fire Lookout Association lists Walker Mountain under Bland and Wythe
Forest Fire Lookout Association row: Wythe, 36.96558, Tower, Gone, FFLOS US 697
evidence.quote: Wythe 36.96558 -81.35196 Tower Gone FFLOS US 697, VA 2

evidence.supports: Big Walker Mountain listed separately under Bland and Wythe
Big Walker Mountain is an observation tower, standing

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register gives Wythe County and its own text places the site in Wythe County; the Forest Fire Lookout Association list gives Bland and Wythe. The record keeps Wythe.

notes_for_editor: The 1938 build year and the dismantling rest on one register description; no second source was found. Two web searches found no staffing, fire history or removal date. Not used: the easternuslookouts.weebly.com page titled Walker Mountain, which is for Union, Windham County, a different site; and Big Walker Lookout near Wytheville (37.04575, -81.22835), a separate standing tower that the Virginia list records.
